tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Endpoints for viewing and managing triggered alerts

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: Endpoints for viewing system audit logs

tags.name: Log Search
tags.description: Endpoints for searching and viewing ingested logs

put.description: Updates an existing alert rule. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS.

delete.description: Deletes an alert rule. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS.

get.description: Returns a list of all registered services. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS.

post.description: Registers a new service and returns a plaintext API Key. WARNING: The plaintext API Key is returned only once in this response. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN.
Authenticates a user by username and password. Returns a JWT for API authorization.

get.description: Returns a list of alert rules, optionally filtered by service and environment. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS.

200.description: Successfully retrieved list of alert rules

post.description: Creates a new alert rule. Note: conditionValue is required if conditionType is PATTERN_MATCH. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS.

patch.description: Updates the status of a specific service. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN.
Changes the status of a TRIGGERED or ACKNOWLEDGED alert to RESOLVED. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS.

409.description: Conflict (alert already resolved or cannot be resolved)

patch.description: Changes the status of a TRIGGERED alert to ACKNOWLEDGED. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS, DEVELOPER.

409.description: Conflict (alert not in correct state for acknowledgment)

patch.summary: Enable or disable an alert rule
patch.description: Toggles the enabled state of an alert rule. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS.

get.description: Search logs with various filters. Note: Pagination can be done via `page`/`size` (up to 10k limit) OR via `search_after` for deep pagination. When searching by `traceId`, results are sorted ascending by timestamp. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS, DEVELOPER, VIEWER (authenticated).

parameters.name: traceId
parameters.description: Filter by trace ID (forces ASC sorting)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Full text search query on log message

parameters.name: search_after
parameters.description: Cursor for deep pagination. Use the `nextSearchAfter` value from the previous response.

get.description: Returns a list of audit logs. DEVOPS role is restricted to viewing logs for services and alert-rules only. ADMIN can view all logs. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS.

200.description: Successfully retrieved list of audit logs

get.description: Returns a list of alerts filtered by service, environment, or status. Status is a single string, e.g. TRIGGERED, ACKNOWLEDGED, RESOLVED. Yêu cầu role: ADMIN, DEVOPS, DEVELOPER, VIEWER (authenticated).

post.description: Accepts a single log event. Duplicate `eventId`s are accepted (202) but not forwarded to Kafka. Sensitive data in specific fields may be masked.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked API Key

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this service

post.summary: Ingest a batch of log events
post.description: Accepts multiple log events in a single request. Rate limit applies per request, not per event inside the batch.

202.description: Batch log events accepted for processing

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked API Key

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this service

post.summary: Ingest a raw JSON array of log events (Agent-friendly)
post.description: Accepts multiple log events as a raw JSON array. Used by log shippers like Fluent Bit. Rate limit applies per request, not per event inside the batch.

202.description: Batch log events accepted for processing

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked API Key

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this service
